packages.description: Opt-in ASP.NET Core administration endpoints.
Provider-neutral administration contracts and extension points.
Deterministic test doubles for platform administration contracts.

Provider-neutral adoption diagnostics core: explicit-directory SDK, package pinning, test-boundary, and project-quality checks with preview-only alignment suggestions, stable JSON, and secret-free evidence. No production package dependencies; never modifies the inspected target.
AI provider routing and policy orchestration.
Raw HTTP Anthropic AI adapter.
Provider-neutral AI contracts.
Raw HTTP Ollama AI adapter.
Raw HTTP OpenAI-compatible AI adapter.
Deterministic AI provider test doubles.
ASP.NET Core integration helpers built on top of Platform.Core.
Optional ASP.NET Core request, exception, and security audit capture adapters.
Provider-neutral audit event, scope, enrichment, masking, sink, retention, and failure-policy contracts.
Optional EF Core change-capture interceptor for the auditing contracts.
Provider-neutral permission and authorization contracts.
Provider-neutral billing orchestration contracts and workflows.
Normalized subscription and entitlement contracts. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Stripe SDKs, or application projects.
Optional Lemon Squeezy billing provider adapter.
Optional Stripe billing provider adapter.
Deterministic billing provider and entitlement test doubles.

Build-only package carrying the platform's shared MSBuild policy in buildTransitive/Platform.Build.props. Reference it at an exact version to receive the policy with no per-repository copy and no import-by-path.
Provider-neutral cache contracts, keys, telemetry, and in-memory implementation.
Optional Microsoft HybridCache adapter for Platform.Caching.
Optional Redis adapter for Platform.Caching with bounded operations and health state.
Framework-independent shared platform contracts. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Stripe SDKs, or application projects.

Framework-neutral domain primitives: typed entity identity, aggregate roots, transient domain events, money, opt-in markers, and safe domain errors. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Mediator, validation libraries, provider SDKs, or application projects.
Transport-agnostic event-bus contract, envelope shape, and in-process default adapter. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, RabbitMQ, or application projects.
Framework-neutral durable eventing contracts.
Optional EF Core durable eventing persistence adapter.

Optional RabbitMQ adapter for the platform durable eventing contracts. Confirmed publishing, application-owned topology registration, safe transient/permanent failure classification, and bounded waits; the application owns event schemas, queues, migrations, and retry policy.

Optional application-owned feature flag integration. Evaluates flags through an application-provided context resolver and tenant feature filter, and gates endpoints with a safe disabled response. Must not own feature names, rollout state, billing plans, or tenant records. References Microsoft.FeatureManagement only; no EF Core, Polly, or providers.

Optional outbound HTTP resilience integration built on the Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience resilience primitives. Provides bounded retry, timeout, circuit-breaker, and concurrency policies that skip non-idempotent methods by default and preserve caller cancellation. Framework-neutral; no ASP.NET Core, EF Core, or provider references.
Framework-neutral idempotency contract and in-memory default store. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, StackExchange.Redis, or application projects.
ASP.NET Core identity registration and policy helpers.
Provider-neutral identity and authentication contracts.
Optional schema-independent EF Core identity store contracts.
Deterministic identity and authorization test providers.
Engine-neutral scheduling contract: recurring-job attribute, dispatcher, registry, and telemetry surface. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Hangfire, Quartz, or application projects.

Optional Hangfire adapter for Platform.Jobs. Payload dispatch, recurring registration, scoped tenant/subject context restoration, opt-in protected dashboard, and safe storage health; the application owns storage configuration, job definitions, and retry ownership.
Provider-neutral mailing contract: mail message value type, renderer abstraction, and structured send result. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, mail providers, or templating engines.
Optional SendGrid adapter for Platform.Mailing. Normalized send outcomes, safe response classification, and attachments; the application owns retries, templates, and delivery records.

Optional SMTP adapter for Platform.Mailing using MailKit. Normalized send outcomes, explicit TLS/authentication configuration, and attachments; the application owns retries, templates, and delivery records.
Provider-neutral notification and SMS contracts with explicit delivery orchestration.
Deterministic notification and SMS fakes.
Opt-in host observability registration with safe correlation, logging enrichment, tracing, metrics, and provider-status contracts. Does not include an exporter; consumers add their own.
Optional provider-neutral EF Core persistence conventions.

Optional application-owned EF Core migration execution boundary: pending inspection, apply, optional seed and exclusive-execution callbacks, and secret-free failure results. Depends on Platform.Persistence.EfCore and provider-neutral EF Core only. No provider packages, locks, tenant iteration, or seed data.
Optional multitenancy adapter for Platform.Persistence.EfCore with ASP.NET Core scope installation. The package owns no tenant entities, tenant catalog, or migrations.
Optional PostgreSQL adapter for Platform.Persistence.EfCore.
Provider-neutral privacy vocabulary: consent records and policy evaluation, subject-rights contracts, anonymization helpers.
Optional ASP.NET Core privacy adapter over Platform.Privacy contracts: consent-cookie state and category enforcement. No product routes, no banner markup, no subject data knowledge.
Provider-neutral quota contracts and thread-safe in-memory store.

Optional ASP.NET Core quota enforcement adapter over Platform.Quota contracts. Depends on the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App framework reference and Platform.Quota only; no plans, prices, entitlements, units, persistence, or quota limits are embedded.
Deterministic quota testing builders and inspection helpers.
Framework-neutral rate-limit contract and in-memory default backend. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, StackExchange.Redis, or application projects.
Transport-neutral realtime connection, authorization, tenant-routing, payload, and provider-status contracts. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, SignalR, EF Core, Redis, or application projects.

Optional ASP.NET Core SignalR and SSE realtime adapters over Platform.Realtime contracts. Depends on the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App framework reference only; no Redis, SignalR provider, or application dependencies. Backplane selection is application-owned and optional.
Composable application bootstrap over independently adoptable platform capabilities.
Provider-neutral object storage contracts, safe keys, and provider status.
Optional local filesystem adapter for Platform.Storage.
Optional S3-compatible adapter for Platform.Storage.
Default tenant lifecycle orchestrator. Depends on Platform.Tenant.Lifecycle.Contracts; integration with Platform.Persistence.Multitenancy is application-owned. No third-party packages.
Provider-neutral readiness and status adapter for tenant lifecycle. Depends on Platform.Tenant.Lifecycle.Contracts and Platform.Tenant.Lifecycle. No third-party packages.

Provider-neutral tenant provisioning and lifecycle contracts. Framework-neutral; targets net10.0. Zero third-party dependencies. The platform never owns tenant entities, migrations, connection strings, plans, or seed data.
Deterministic fakes for tenant lifecycle tests. Depends on Platform.Tenant.Lifecycle.Contracts; must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Hangfire, or any consumer code.
Reusable testing helpers for platform consumers. Production projects must not reference this package.
ASP.NET Core TestServer host builder for platform consumers. Production projects must not reference this package.
Razor static web assets and conventions equivalent to the platform UI contract.
Composable web runtime foundations built on Platform.AspNetCore.

Optional explicit ASP.NET Core module composition: stable module contract, deterministic ordered registration with duplicate rejection, and opt-in middleware/endpoint mapping without assembly scanning or static state. Depends on Platform.Core only. No Mediator, FluentValidation, EF Core, or product references.
Optional CORS configuration and production validation built on ASP.NET Core. Must not reference EF Core, third-party CORS providers, or application projects.

Optional OpenAPI document registry and explicit mapping helper. The platform does not own a specific OpenAPI implementation; applications supply the document JSON through a provider. Must not reference Swashbuckle, NSwag, EF Core, or application projects.

Optional HTTP client resilience conventions (retry, timeout, circuit breaker) with bounded defaults. Skips retries for non-idempotent methods unless explicitly enabled. Must not reference EF Core, Polly, or application projects.
Framework-neutral redaction-safe web telemetry names and option-validation helpers. Must not reference ASP.NET Core, EF Core, or third-party providers.

Optional API versioning and API Explorer conventions for ASP.NET Core. Application opt-in; unversioned endpoints are unchanged. Depends on the centrally managed Asp.Versioning.Http and Asp.Versioning.Mvc.ApiExplorer packages. Must not reference EF Core, application projects, or non-platform adapters.
Optional ASP.NET Core helpers that capture raw request bytes and sign outbound webhook deliveries.
Provider-neutral inbound verification, replay decisions, outbound subscription, and delivery contracts for webhooks.
Optional EF Core persistence adapters for the webhook inbox, subscriptions, and delivery stores.
